scope: Read-only database inventory and versioned code review. No authenticated UI exercise, external provider call, HTTP dispatch, secret output or runtime mutation.

original_schema.sql:
SELECT table_name, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',column_name,'type',data_type) ORDER BY ordinal_position) AS columns
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN (
'sports_competitions','sports_teams','sports_fixtures','sports_daily_briefings','sports_briefing_items','sports_fact_packs','sports_source_articles','sports_editorial_source_items','sports_broadcast_evidence','sports_team_squads','sports_players','sports_fixture_player_stats','sports_fixture_lineups','sports_player_season_stats','sports_match_reviews','sports_player_personal_ratings','sports_field_marks','sports_jobs','sports_sync_state','sports_api_sync_state','elo_global_team_ratings','elo_team_ratings','elo_league_ratings','elo_fixture_history','elo_sync_state','app_users')
GROUP BY table_name ORDER BY table_name;

queries.sql:
SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at_utc, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') AS observed_at_local,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_competitions) AS competitions,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_competitions WHERE active) AS active_competitions,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_teams) AS teams,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_fixtures) AS fixtures,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_fixtures WHERE kickoff_at >= (CURRENT_DATE AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') AND kickoff_at < ((CURRENT_DATE+1) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')) AS fixtures_local_today,
(SELECT max(source_fetched_at) FROM public.sports_fixtures) AS latest_fixture_fetch,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_players) AS players,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_team_squads WHERE active) AS active_squad_rows,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT team_id) FROM public.sports_team_squads WHERE active) AS teams_with_active_squad_rows,
(SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM public.sports_team_squads) AS latest_squad_fetch,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_fixture_player_stats) AS fixture_player_stats,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT fixture_id) FROM public.sports_fixture_player_stats) AS fixtures_with_player_stats,
(SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM public.sports_fixture_player_stats) AS latest_fixture_player_fetch,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_fixture_lineups) AS lineup_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_player_season_stats) AS player_season_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_match_reviews) AS review_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_player_personal_ratings) AS personal_rating_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.elo_global_team_ratings) AS global_elo_rows,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT team_id) FROM public.elo_global_team_ratings) AS global_elo_unique_teams,
(SELECT max(updated_at) FROM public.elo_global_team_ratings) AS latest_elo_update,
(SELECT max(kickoff_at) FROM public.elo_fixture_history) AS last_elo_fixture;

SELECT b.id, b.briefing_date, b.status, b.generated_at, b.facts_through, b.updated_at,
b.metadata->>'aiEditorialStatus' AS ai_status,
b.metadata->>'aiEditorialCandidates' AS ai_candidates,
b.metadata->>'aiEditorialItems' AS ai_updated_items,
b.metadata->>'aiEditorialBatchErrors' AS ai_batch_errors,
length(b.football_summary) AS opening_characters,
count(i.id) AS item_count,
count(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.item_kind='FOOTBALL_MATCH') AS football_match_items,
count(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.item_kind='FOOTBALL_MATCH' AND length(coalesce(i.body,''))>0) AS football_items_with_text,
count(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.facts->'editorialStats'->>'source'='SofaScore') AS items_with_sofascore_stats
FROM public.sports_daily_briefings b LEFT JOIN public.sports_briefing_items i ON i.briefing_id=b.id
GROUP BY b.id ORDER BY b.briefing_date DESC, b.updated_at DESC LIMIT 8;

SELECT table_schema, table_name FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE (table_schema='public' AND (table_name LIKE 'sports_%' OR table_name LIKE '%app_user%' OR table_name LIKE '%allow%' OR table_name LIKE '%elo%target%'))
OR (table_schema IN ('cron','auth') AND table_name IN ('job','job_run_details','users','sessions'))
ORDER BY table_schema,table_name;

SELECT job_type,status,count(*) AS jobs, min(available_at) AS oldest_available_at,
max(updated_at) AS latest_update, max(completed_at) AS latest_completed_at,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_error IS NOT NULL) AS with_error
FROM public.sports_jobs GROUP BY job_type,status ORDER BY job_type,status;

SELECT table_schema, table_name, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',column_name,'type',data_type) ORDER BY ordinal_position) AS columns
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE (table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('sports_editorial_source_evidence','sports_match_fact_packs','sports_review_field_marks','sports_prospective_collection_state','sports_team_competitions','sports_tracking_rules','automation_runs','elo_target_leagues','sports_player_period_aggregates'))
OR (table_schema='net' AND table_name='_http_response')
GROUP BY table_schema,table_name ORDER BY table_schema,table_name;
SELECT jobid,jobname,schedule,active FROM cron.job ORDER BY jobid;

SELECT provider,domain,season,last_attempt_at,last_success_at,updated_at,
last_error IS NOT NULL AS has_error,
CASE WHEN last_error IS NULL THEN NULL
WHEN last_error ILIKE '%404%' THEN 'HTTP_404'
WHEN last_error ILIKE '%401%' OR last_error ILIKE '%unauthorized%' THEN 'AUTH_401'
WHEN last_error ILIKE '%403%' THEN 'HTTP_403'
WHEN last_error ILIKE '%429%' OR last_error ILIKE '%rate limit%' THEN 'RATE_LIMIT'
WHEN last_error ILIKE '%timeout%' THEN 'TIMEOUT'
WHEN last_error ILIKE '%key%ausente%' OR last_error ILIKE '%not configured%' THEN 'MISSING_CONFIGURATION'
ELSE 'OTHER_REDACTED' END AS error_class
FROM public.sports_sync_state ORDER BY provider,domain,season;

SELECT j.jobname,d.status,count(*) AS runs,max(d.start_time) AS last_start,max(d.end_time) AS last_end,
CASE WHEN d.return_message ILIKE '%404%' THEN 'HTTP_404'
WHEN d.return_message ILIKE '%401%' OR d.return_message ILIKE '%unauthorized%' THEN 'AUTH_401'
WHEN d.return_message ILIKE '%403%' THEN 'HTTP_403'
WHEN d.return_message ILIKE '%timeout%' THEN 'TIMEOUT'
WHEN d.return_message ILIKE '%could not connect%' THEN 'CONNECTION_ERROR'
WHEN d.return_message ILIKE '%succeeded%' THEN 'SUCCESS_MESSAGE'
ELSE 'OTHER_REDACTED' END AS message_class
FROM cron.job_run_details d JOIN cron.job j ON j.jobid=d.jobid
WHERE d.start_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY j.jobname,d.status,message_class ORDER BY j.jobname,d.status,message_class;

SELECT job_name,status,http_status,count(*) AS runs,max(started_at) AS last_start,max(finished_at) AS last_finish,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE error_message IS NOT NULL) AS with_error
FROM public.automation_runs
WHERE started_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY job_name,status,http_status ORDER BY job_name,status,http_status;

SELECT briefing_date,status,metadata->>'releaseFailure' AS release_failure,
metadata->>'factualItems' AS factual_items,metadata->>'journalismMatchItems' AS journalism_matches,
metadata->>'otherSportsItems' AS other_sports_items,metadata->>'releaseItemCount' AS released_items
FROM public.sports_daily_briefings WHERE briefing_date>='2026-10-07' ORDER BY briefing_date DESC;

SELECT name, decrypted_secret='https://value-bet-engine.lovable.app' AS points_to_previous_recorded_url
FROM vault.decrypted_secrets WHERE name='sports_worker_base_url';

SELECT
clock_timestamp() AS observed_at_utc,(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') AS observed_at_local,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_fixtures WHERE kickoff_at >= (((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')
AND kickoff_at < ((((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date)+1) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')) AS fixtures_local_today,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_fixtures WHERE kickoff_at >= ((((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date)-1) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')
AND kickoff_at < (((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')) AS fixtures_local_yesterday,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_broadcast_evidence) AS broadcast_rows,
(SELECT max(checked_at) FROM public.sports_broadcast_evidence) AS latest_broadcast_check,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_editorial_source_evidence) AS editorial_evidence_rows,
(SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM public.sports_editorial_source_evidence) AS latest_editorial_fetch,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_match_fact_packs) AS fact_pack_rows,
(SELECT max(generated_at) FROM public.sports_match_fact_packs) AS latest_fact_pack,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_standings) AS standings_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_player_period_aggregates) AS player_period_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_review_field_marks) AS field_marks,
(SELECT count(*) FROM auth.users) AS auth_users,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_match_reviews WHERE notes IS NOT NULL AND length(notes)>0) AS reviews_with_notes,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_match_reviews WHERE watched IS TRUE) AS watched_reviews;

SELECT id,model_version,last_started_at,last_completed_at,last_status,leagues_processed,fixtures_fetched,api_requests,updated_at,
error_message IS NOT NULL AS has_error FROM public.elo_sync_state ORDER BY id;

SELECT status_code,count(*) AS responses,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE content ILIKE '%Project not found%') AS project_not_found,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE content ILIKE '%Unauthorized%') AS unauthorized_body,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE error_msg IS NOT NULL) AS transport_error
FROM net._http_response WHERE created>=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-INTERVAL '6 hours'
GROUP BY status_code ORDER BY status_code;

SELECT
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_match_reviews WHERE status='PENDING') AS pending_reviews,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_match_reviews WHERE status='COMPLETED') AS completed_reviews,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_match_reviews WHERE status='AUTO_CLOSED') AS auto_closed_reviews,
(SELECT count(*) FROM auth.users WHERE raw_app_meta_data->>'provider'='google') AS google_accounts,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sports_jobs WHERE status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND available_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS overdue_jobs,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.automation_runs) AS all_automation_runs,
(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('day_zero_at',day_zero_at,'activated_at',activated_at,'definition_version',definition_version)) FROM public.sports_prospective_collection_state) AS prospective_state;

SELECT n.nspname AS schema,c.relname,c.relrowsecurity AS rls_enabled
FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ('sports_match_reviews','sports_player_personal_ratings','sports_review_field_marks','push_subscriptions')
ORDER BY c.relname;

SELECT p.proname,
position('sports_worker_base_url' IN pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))>0 AS references_worker_base_url,
position('net.http_post' IN pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))>0 AS direct_http_post,
position('kick_sports_job_worker' IN pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))>0 AS calls_worker_kick
FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN ('kick_sports_job_worker','kick_sports_daily_sync','kick_editorial_source_sync','kick_editorial_ai_refinement','kick_sports_api_maintenance','is_approved_app_user','erase_user_application_data')
ORDER BY p.proname;

SELECT c.name,c.country_code,c.season,c.api_football_league_id,
count(DISTINCT tc.team_id) FILTER (WHERE tc.active) AS active_team_memberships,
count(DISTINCT tc.team_id) FILTER (WHERE tc.active AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sports_team_squads s WHERE s.team_id=tc.team_id AND s.active)) AS memberships_with_active_squad_rows
FROM public.sports_competitions c LEFT JOIN public.sports_team_competitions tc ON tc.competition_id=c.id
WHERE c.competition_kind='LEAGUE' AND c.division_level=1 AND c.country_code IN ('DE','ES','FR','IT','GB-ENG','BR') AND c.api_football_league_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.id,c.name,c.country_code,c.season,c.api_football_league_id ORDER BY c.country_code,c.name;

limitations: Snapshots from separate SELECTs; not a single atomic transaction.
HTTP response samples cannot be individually attributed to dispatches because automation_runs has zero rows.
RLS flags and Google account existence do not prove authorization or login.
Rows in squads do not prove complete/fresh rosters.
Zero stored fixtures is not proof of no official matches.
UTC rolled to 2026-10-16 while local date remained 2026-10-15.
